Privacy Policy
tnaflix – YOUNGTEK SOLUTIONS LIMITED
Effective Date: 23/05/2025
Last Updated: 23/05/2025
Youngtek Solutions Limited
(“Company,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) operates
tnaflix
.com
(“Site”)—a free adult content streaming website. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency regarding the collection, use, and processing of personal data.
This Privacy Policy explains how
tnaflix
collects, uses, discloses, and protects your information in accordance with:
General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”)
California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”)
U.S. Federal & State Data Protection Laws
Applicable International Data Protection Regulations
By accessing or using our website, you acknowledge and agree to the collection and processing of your data as described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you must immediately cease using this website.
For any privacy-related inquiries, you may contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO), Valera Toncu, at:
Email:
support@tnaflix.com
Address: Alvonos 1, Maria House, Nicosia 1075, Cyprus

1. WHO WE ARE & LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING
Youngtek Solutions Limited is a data controller under the GDPR and other applicable regulations. We process personal data:
With user consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR)
To fulfill contractual obligations (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR)
For compliance with legal obligations (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR)
For legitimate business interests (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR)
If you are a resident of California, we process personal data in accordance with the CCPA, which grants you specific rights over your personal information (see Section 8).

2. WHAT INFORMATION WE COLLECT
When you use
tnaflix
, we collect two types of data:
Personal Data (Identifiable Information)
You may voluntarily provide personally identifiable information (PII) when engaging with our services, including:
Account Information: Username, email address, password
Contact Information: Email (if provided for customer support)
User-Generated Content: Any videos, comments, or messages you post
Legal Compliance Data: Any identification or verification documents required for compliance
Automatically Collected Data (Non-Identifiable Information)
When you visit
tnaflix
, we may collect non-identifiable usage data through automated means, including:
IP Address & Device Data (browser type, OS, country of access)
Cookies & Tracking Technologies (see Section 6 for details)
Usage Data (video preferences, time spent on the site, interactions)
We do NOT collect or store sensitive personal data
such as racial/ethnic origin, religious beliefs, political opinions, or biometric data.

3. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
Providing & Improving Services
– Operating, maintaining, and optimizing
tnaflix
.
Enhancing User Experience
– Customizing content recommendations and personalizing your experience.
Security & Fraud Prevention
– Detecting fraudulent activity, securing user accounts, and protecting against abuse.
Legal & Regulatory Compliance
– Ensuring compliance with GDPR, CCPA, DMCA, and law enforcement obligations.
Marketing & Communications
– Sending occasional service updates, promotions (only with user consent).
We do NOT sell your personal data to third parties.

4. HOW WE SHARE YOUR INFORMATION
With service providers & partners – Hosting providers, content delivery networks.
With law enforcement & legal authorities – In cases of legal obligations, CSAM reports, copyright violations, or fraud investigations.
During business transitions – In case of mergers, acquisitions, or asset transfers.
For content moderation – When removing illegal or violating content under site policies.
We do NOT share or sell user data to advertisers or third-party marketing firms.

5. YOUR DATA PROTECTION RIGHTS
Under GDPR & CCPA, you have the following rights over your personal data:
Right to Access
– Request a copy of the data we hold about you.
Right to Rectification
– Request corrections to inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to Erasure (“Right to Be Forgotten”)
– Request deletion of your personal data.
Right to Restriction of Processing
– Request limited processing of your data.
Right to Data Portability
– Request a structured, machine-readable copy of your data.
Right to Object
– Object to processing of your data for direct marketing purposes.
Right to Withdraw Consent
– Withdraw your consent to processing at any time.
To exercise your rights, contact us at:
support@tnaflix.com

6. COOKIES & TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES
tnaflix
uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. You may control cookie settings via your browser preferences or through our Cookie Consent Manager.
For full details, review our
Cookie Policy
.

7. DATA SECURITY MEASURES
Encryption
– Secure HTTPS, TLS encryption for data transmission.
Access Controls
– Restricted access to sensitive user data.
Anonymization & Pseudonymization
– Where applicable.
Regular Security Audits
– To detect and prevent breaches.
No online platform is 100% secure. Users should take additional precautions (e.g., using strong passwords, enabling two-factor authentication where available).

8. SPECIAL NOTICE FOR CALIFORNIA RESIDENTS (CCPA COMPLIANCE)
If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the CCPA, including:
Right to Know
– Request details on what personal information we collect.
Right to Opt-Out
– Opt-out of the sale of your personal data (though we do not sell data).
Right to Non-Discrimination
– We will not discriminate against users for exercising their privacy rights.
To make a CCPA request, email us at:
support@tnaflix.com

9. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY
This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Users are encouraged to review it regularly. Continued use of
tnaflix
constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
Last Updated:
23/05/2025

10. CONTACT US
For any privacy-related inquiries, contact our DPO, Valera Toncu:
Email:
support@tnaflix.com
Address: Alvonos 1, Maria House, Nicosia 1075, Cyprus
tnaflix
remains committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring compliance with global data protection standards.
